adminPrefix.description: The admin panel URL prefix (default is "admin").

clientId.description: The OAuth Client ID from your OroCommerce OAuth application.

clientSecret.description: The OAuth Client Secret from your OroCommerce OAuth application.

headers.description: JSON object of headers sent with every action. Step headers win. Authorization is ignored.

isInternalInfrastructure.description: Setting this option allows to rewrite network-related connection options with values provied in ENV variables.

serverUrl.description: The base URL of your OroCommerce instance (e.g., https://your-store.com).

create_customer.description: Creates a new customer (company) record in OroCommerce.

additionalAttributes.description: Custom fields, merged after the standard ones. Example: {"myField": "value"}

additionalHeaders.description: Headers for this step; override the connection defaults. Authorization is ignored. Example: {"X-Include": "totalCount"}

additionalRelations.description: Custom relationships in linkage format. Example: {"myRelation": {"data": {"type": "myentities", "id": "1"}}}

addresses.description: Customer addresses to create along with the customer.

externalId.description: A unique identifier from an external system.

name.description: A human-readable name that identifies the customer (company).

organization.description: The organization this record belongs to.

owner.description: The back-office user who owns this record. Search by name, username or email.

parent.description: The parent company this customer (division) reports to.

vat_id.description: Customer's value added tax identification number.

create_customer_user.description: Creates a new customer user (storefront account) in OroCommerce.

additionalAttributes.description: Custom fields, merged after the standard ones. Example: {"myField": "value"}

additionalHeaders.description: Headers for this step; override the connection defaults. Authorization is ignored. Example: {"X-Include": "totalCount"}

additionalRelations.description: Custom relationships in linkage format. Example: {"myRelation": {"data": {"type": "myentities", "id": "1"}}}

addresses.description: Customer user addresses to create along with the user.

confirmed.description: Marks the account confirmed without sending a confirmation email. Defaults to true.

customer.description: The customer this order belongs to.

email.description: Email address of the customer user. Used as the login.

enabled.description: When disabled the user cannot log into the storefront. Defaults to true, so the account is active as soon as it is created.

externalId.description: A unique identifier from an external system.

organization.description: The organization this record belongs to.

owner.description: The back-office user who owns this record. Search by name, username or email.

password.description: Password for the new account. Prefer a value from a secret store over a literal one.

userRoles.description: The complete set of customer user roles. Saving replaces the existing roles, so include every role the customer user should keep.

website.description: The website this customer user is associated with. OroCommerce Enterprise rejects a create without it; the Community Edition leaves it optional.

create_invoice.description: Creates a new invoice record in OroCommerce.

additionalAttributes.description: Custom fields, merged after the standard ones. Example: {"myField": "value"}

additionalHeaders.description: Headers for this step; override the connection defaults. Authorization is ignored. Example: {"X-Include": "totalCount"}

additionalRelations.description: Custom relationships in linkage format. Example: {"myRelation": {"data": {"type": "myentities", "id": "1"}}}

billTo.description: Billing address HTML string (e.g. 123 Main St, City, Country).

customerName.description: Name of the company being billed. Stored as a plain-text label on the invoice.

externalPaymentUrl.description: URL for the external payment page.

invoiceNumber.description: Sequential invoice number (e.g. INV-2026-00001). Auto-generated if left empty.

invoicePdfContent.description: Base64-encoded PDF, with or without a data: prefix. Attached to the invoice as its default PDF.

invoicePdfFilename.description: Filename for the attached PDF. Defaults to invoice.pdf.

lineItems.description: Invoice line items. Each item is sent via JSON:API included.

memo.description: Short memo visible on the invoice (e.g. "Thank you!").

organization.description: The organization this record belongs to.

owner.description: The back-office user who owns this record. Search by name, username or email.

refCustomerId.description: An optional ID reference to a customer. Can be used for storing an arbitrary external ID.

refCustomerUserId.description: An optional ID reference to a customer user. Can be used for storing an arbitrary external ID.

title.description: Alternative invoice title that reflects its nature.

totalAmount.description: Total invoice amount. Should equal the sum of all line item row totals.

website.description: The website this record is associated with.

create_order.description: Creates a new order record in OroCommerce.

additionalAttributes.description: Custom fields, merged after the standard ones. Example: {"myField": "value"}

additionalHeaders.description: Headers for this step; override the connection defaults. Authorization is ignored. Example: {"X-Include": "totalCount"}

additionalRelations.description: Custom relationships in linkage format. Example: {"myRelation": {"data": {"type": "myentities", "id": "1"}}}

billingAddressCountry.description: ISO-3166 country. Start typing to filter the list.

billingAddressCustomRegion.description: Free-text region for countries without predefined regions.

billingAddressRegion.description: Region or state. Select a country first. Start typing to filter.

customer.description: The customer this order belongs to.

customerNotes.description: Notes from the customer (e.g. "Call before delivery").

disablePromotions.description: Prevent the promotions engine from running for this order.

estimatedShippingCostAmount.description: Shipping cost calculated from the selected shipping method.

organization.description: The organization this record belongs to.

overriddenShippingCostAmount.description: Custom shipping cost that overrides the calculated value.

owner.description: The back-office user who owns this record. Search by name, username or email.

parent.description: Search orders to use as the parent order.

poNumber.description: Purchase order number provided by the buyer.

shipUntil.description: Latest acceptable ship date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

shippingAddressCountry.description: ISO-3166 country. Start typing to filter the list.

shippingAddressCustomRegion.description: Free-text region for countries without predefined regions.

shippingAddressRegion.description: Region or state. Select a country first. Start typing to filter.

shippingMethod.description: The shipping method selected for the order (e.g. "flat_rate_2").

status.description: Order status managed by an external system (only relevant when "Enable External Status Management" is on).

website.description: The website this record is associated with.

enabled.description: When disabled the user cannot log in. Defaults to true.

groups.description: The complete set of back-office groups for the user. Saving replaces the existing groups, so include every group the user should keep.

organization.description: The organization this record belongs to.

organizations.description: The complete set of organizations the user has access to. Saving replaces the existing list, so include every organization the user should keep.

password.description: Password for the new account. Prefer a value from a secret store over a literal one.

username.description: Login name for the user. Must be unique.

custom_api_call.description: Make a direct authenticated call to the OroCommerce JSON:API.

failsafe.description: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.

followRedirects.description: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.

headers.description: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.

response_is_binary.description: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.

timeout.description: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).

serialize_jsonapi.description: Builds a JSON:API request body from a plain object. Add "_meta": {"update": true} to an embedded record to update it instead of creating a new one.

attributes.description: A flat object, Unserialize output, or a single-resource JSON:API document. Values marked with _type or shaped like {"type","id"} become relationships.

included.description: Extra resources to embed. Forwarded automatically when Attributes already has "included".

relationships.description: Wins over anything detected in Attributes. Example: {"customer":{"type":"customers","id":"42"}}

resourceId.description: Leave empty to create a record, or when the input carries an id.

resourceType.description: e.g. orders, invoices, products. Taken from _type when left empty.

unserialize_jsonapi.description: Flattens a JSON:API response body into a plain object. Included relationships are inlined, and the result stays re-serializable.

response.description: The "body" output of the API Call action. Needs a top-level "data" key.
